# YOEDO (You Only Eat Durian Once) — Durian Leaf Scanner

> YOEDO is a free, 100% offline Android mobile application for real-time durian leaf disease detection, built for durian farmers and researchers.

## Key Facts
- **Website:** https://yoedo.vercel.app/
- **About & Research Page:** https://yoedo.vercel.app/about
- **Privacy Policy:** https://yoedo.vercel.app/privacy-policy
- **App Name:** YOEDO (Durian Leaf Scanner)
- **Package ID:** `com.cateatmars_dev.yoedodurian`
- **Google Play Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cateatmars_dev.yoedodurian
- **Open-Source Repository (Apache-2.0):** https://github.com/marsfinncode/cnn-durian
- **Research Paper (ResearchGate):** https://www.researchgate.net/publication/417063848_YOEDO_A_Real-Time_Mobile_Application_for_Durian_Leaf_Disease_Detection_Using_YOLO-OBB
- **Languages Supported in App:** Thai and English
- **Operation:** 100% on-device offline AI inference using YOLO-OBB quantized to TensorFlow Lite (LiteRT)
- **Dataset:** 4,668 annotated durian leaf instances collected from real orchard environments

## Supported Detection Classes (7 Classes)
1. **Phytophthora Root & Stem Rot** (*Phytophthora palmivora*) — Critical
2. **Anthracnose Leaf Blight** (*Colletotrichum spp.*) — Critical
3. **Rhizoctonia Leaf Blight** (*Rhizoctonia solani*) — Warning
4. **Phomopsis Leaf Spot** (*Phomopsis spp.*) — Warning
5. **Algal Leaf Spot** (*Cephaleuros virescens*) — Monitor
6. **Healthy Leaf** — Normal
7. **Others** — Other anomalies outside the 5 main diseases

## Features
- Real-time live camera scanning with oriented bounding boxes (YOLO-OBB)
- Whole-tree scan statistics (donut chart summarizing healthy vs. diseased leaf proportions)
- Gallery image analysis
- Built-in 7-class durian leaf disease database with pathogen details and early care guidance
- Privacy by Design: zero personal data collection, zero tracking, no ads
